description: Observed-order sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/godunov_upwind_D1x_extrapolate_bc and godunov_upwind_D1y_extrapolate_bc driven by problems/godunov_upwind_D1_2d_paraboloid_mms.esm, binding NX=NY together. L2 and Linf; expected order 1.
